meta.title: Dejan Dembicki — Mechanical Technician & CNC Operator
meta.description: Dejan Dembicki, mechanical technician and CNC operator working on glass and metal processing. Experience, projects, interests and contact.
hero.lead: I run CNC machines for glass and metal processing. I enjoy precise work, where mistakes are measured in hundredths of a millimetre and the result is something you can hold in your hand.
hero.photoAlt: DD logo: a hex nut on a technical drawing grid
about.title: About me
about.p1: I am a mechanical technician by training. I have worked as a CNC operator in glass and metal processing: from reading the technical drawing and preparing the program, through setting up the machine and tools, to checking the finished part.
about.p2: What matters most to me is that work is done accurately and safely. I like to understand how a machine works rather than just pressing "start". That curiosity is also how this website came to be.
about.skills: CNC machining, G-code, technical drawings, precision measuring, tool setup
experience.title: Work history
experience.glass.description: Operating a CNC machine for glass: cutting, edge grinding and drilling to measure. Tool setup, process monitoring and dimensional inspection of finished pieces.
experience.metal.description: Machining metal parts from technical drawings. Entering and correcting programs, choosing and changing tools, measuring with callipers and micrometers.
experience.school.description: Technical drawing, machine elements, machining technology and the basics of CNC programming.

privacy.storageTitle: What is stored in your browser
privacy.storage: The site remembers your chosen language and theme (light or dark) in your browser's local storage. This stays on your device, is never sent anywhere, and you can delete it at any time by clearing the site data in your browser.
privacy.thirdParties: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, and its fonts are loaded from Google Fonts. Like any web server, they receive your IP address and basic browser details when the page loads. How they handle this data is described in the privacy policies of GitHub and Google.
